title: Window Cleaning Equipment Inspection Report Form
subtitle: Control access setup, exclusion, glass cleaning, equipment control, inspection, and release through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete window cleaning equipment inspection report for windows, frames, anchors, ladders, lifts, ropes, tools, and exclusion zones. It connects work plan, access method, anchors, products, and site approval to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a trained window-cleaning technician must inspect windows, frames, anchors, ladders, lifts, ropes, tools, and exclusion zones against stated criteria and issue a traceable condition, restriction, corrective-action, or release decision.

sections.title: Window Cleaning inspection scope, criteria, and readiness
sections.guidance: Do not infer whole-asset or whole-site condition from a limited, inaccessible, or unqualified inspection.

sections.title: Window Cleaning equipment inspection report closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This window cleaning equipment inspection report is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when anchorage, access equipment, fall protection, rescue, weather, electrical, public exclusion, facade, glass, or drop-zone condition is uncertain. A access and fall-protection supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
